name: JustHunt

sources.title: Homepage — weekly launch cohorts (787 products scheduled), 'FREE DR 45+ backlink', 50k+ founders claim
Submit page — 3-step wizard (URL → Details → Launch); auto-fetches product title, description, logo

requirements: Free submission marketed as taking ~45 seconds; products are queued into weekly launch cohorts (UTC weeks)
Products go through an approval step — 'Approved products for the current UTC week will appear here automatically'
Website URL is the entry point — the wizard auto-fetches title, description, and logo from the site
Sign-in link present; an account is likely required to manage/track the submission
preparation: Canonical product URL with good OpenGraph metadata — the wizard scrapes title, description, and logo automatically
Corrected title/description ready in case auto-fetch grabs the wrong text
Product logo and category choice (SaaS & Tools, AI & ML, Developer Tools, etc.)
workflow: Open https://justhunt.co/submit and enter the product's website URL (step 1 auto-fetches metadata)
Complete the Details step (verify/edit fetched title, description, logo, category)
Confirm the Launch step — the product is scheduled into an upcoming weekly cohort
Once approved, the product appears in 'Upcoming Startup Launches' and competes in its launch week (top-3 weekly winners get prizes)
watchFor: Weekly-cohort model: approval schedules you for a future week — 787 products were queued, so launch week may be weeks out
Heavy upsell surface: 'Boost DR' directory-submission service, Ads pricing page, Launch Boost — the core listing is free but promotions are pushed
Products can be submitted 'by Anonymous' — auth may be optional for basic submission
Marketing claims (DR 45+ backlink, 50k founders) are unverified — treat as promotional
countsAsLive: The product appears under 'Upcoming Startup Launches' with a scheduled date, then moves into 'Launching This Week' and gets a /startups/<slug> page during its cohort week
unknowns: Whether an account is strictly required (sign-in exists but anonymous submissions appear in the queue)
Whether the promised backlink is dofollow once live
